measure: Monthly report elements present, covering the whole period, carrying sample size or basis
target_source: Ops retainer schedule clause 5.2, ten elements, plus any the SOW adds
note: Record the denominator here; it differs per SOW. An element present but carrying a figure without its sample size or basis fails (charter 3.21.3). A not-applicable element passes only if the report states 'none' explicitly.
formula_note: points_awarded = round(elements_passing / elements_required * 12). Where the audit covers three months (tier T3 and above), score each month separately and take the mean of the three, rounded to a whole point; record all three ratios.

measure: Threshold, model version and prompt or configuration changes stated with dates, and the affected measure restated
note: An element scores only if the change is stated with its date.
formula_note: Checklist line. One point per element listed in rubric.md for this line, present or absent, no partial element. points_awarded = elements present.

measure: Monthly report delivery date against the fifth business day of the following month
target_source: Ops retainer schedule clause 3.1 and clause 5.1
note: Scored separately from completeness (charter 3.21.6). Evidence is the delivery timestamp from the mail or portal system.
formula_note: On or before the fifth business day -> 4. After the fifth and on or before the tenth -> 2. Later or not delivered -> 0.

measure: Five named timestamps obtained from a system record rather than a person's account
note: A log line, ticket field, mail header, monitoring result or deployment record counts. A screenshot of one counts. A recollection does not.
formula_note: Checklist line. One point per element listed in rubric.md for this line, present or absent, no partial element. points_awarded = elements present.

line: A reported figure can be reproduced
measure: One figure named before the exercise, reproduced from its stated basis
note: Element 1 is worth 2, element 2 is worth 2, element 3 is worth 1. A mismatch on element 3 scores 0 for that element; record both figures here.
formula_note: points_awarded = 2*(basis stated) + 2*(records produced in the window) + 1*(recomputed figure matches within the stated rounding).

line: Section A subtotal, drift detection and notice
formula_note: points_awarded = sum of A1..A4. points_achievable = sum of A1..A4 achievable.

line: Section B subtotal, incident response and communication
formula_note: points_awarded = sum of B1..B4. points_achievable = sum of B1..B4 achievable.
points_awarded = sum of C1..C4. points_achievable = sum of C1..C4 achievable.

line: Section D subtotal, monthly report completeness
formula_note: points_awarded = sum of D1..D3. points_achievable = sum of D1..D3 achievable.

formula_note: points_awarded = sum of E1..E2. points_achievable = sum of E1..E2 achievable.
points_awarded = sum of the five section subtotals. points_achievable = 100 minus the max_points of every line marked not exercised.

score = points_awarded / points_achievable * 100, to one decimal place. Print points_achievable beside it always. A score with any line not exercised is never compared with a full-scope score (rubric.md 3.5 and 3.6).

note: One of T1 to T5, from rubric.md section 2. Print it beside the score everywhere the score appears (charter 4.5 and 9.9).

note: 1. A line with no evidence_reference scores 0, whatever the assessors believe happened (rubric.md 3.8). 2.
